Get to know me

About Me

Full-Stack Developer & AI engineer-in-training — turning complex problems into elegant, production-ready systems.

Hello! I'm Rishabh Gupta — a full-stack developer driven by curiosity and the desire to solve complex problems, experienced in building scalable systems.

My work spans production-ready platforms, payment systems, custom model training pipelines, and three-sided marketplaces. I've shipped 15+ REST APIs in a single project, integrated Razorpay payments end-to-end, fine-tuned LLaMA 3 models on Google Colab T4 GPUs and exported GGUF artifacts for Ollama, and architected blockchain-inspired tokenization flows for real-world assets.

I care about the small things — clean architecture, JWT auth done right, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and UI that feels alive. 250+ DSA problems on LeetCode keep my fundamentals sharp.

Currently exploring AI infrastructure, agentic systems, and the intersection of LLMs with developer tooling. Always open to internships, collaborations & opportunities where curiosity is rewarded over fear.
